effects.effect: Apply these effects, in sequence, depending on the number of "Ice Barrier" Synchro Monsters you control with different names; ● 1+: Banish 1 card your opponent controls. ● 2+: Banish 1 card from your opponent's GY. ● 3+: Banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
effects.window: Any time this Set card can be activated (either player's turn), if you control at least 1 "Ice Barrier" Synchro Monster

effects.cost: banish this card from your GY
effects.window: While this card is in your GY, when your opponent activates a card or effect that targets an "Ice Barrier" Synchro Monster(s) you control
